black.description: Black is the color of industry, urban civilization, organization, infrastructure, and material ambition. Its world is filled with bustling cities, ingenious steam-powered machinery, magnificent public works, ambitious construction projects, commerce, and elaborate institutions. Black celebrates the ingenuity of engineers, the pride of craftsmen, the solidarity of workers, and humanity's determination to transform the world through technology and organization. Its personality is practical, industrious, confident, and occasionally pompous. A distinctive part of its charm is whimsical, Dickensian absurdity: unnecessarily complicated machines, eccentric industrialists, officious bureaucrats, overzealous inspectors, stubborn automatons, ridiculous municipal regulations, and ambitious inventions solving trivial problems. Black can be prosperous, colorful, lively, heroic, and humorous, not merely dark or oppressive. Its darker side includes exploitation, pollution, corruption, ruthless efficiency, and the decay of neglected infrastructure. Death, necromancy, cemeteries, and gothic horror are rare secondary themes. Favor tangible machinery, architecture, physical labor, urban activity, engineering feats, and expressive characters over books, paperwork, archives, or abstract knowledge, which belong primarily to blue. The overall aesthetic is whimsical industrial fantasy with a strong steampunk influence, inspired by the bustling cities and mechanical imagination of the nineteenth century.
